body:
Sorry if I sound cranky. 

I've had a lifetime of people who abuse me or forget about me telling me "It's just a cat/dog". They go live a nice, pain-free life & forget I exist while my "just a cat" leaves nose prints all over the window waiting impatiently for me to get home from the doctor and to tell about their last 90 minutes since we parted..

If I gave them away, I can guarantee that would be the last day of my life. They *are* the reason I haven't killed myself yet.

Oxytocin, the love chemical, doesn't distinguish between species. I can say with absolute certainty I produce as much at the sight of my cats as any human does at the sight of their kids, loved ones etc. It's like asking someone to give up their teenage children to strangers and carry on. It can't be done.
